description: NaSrPH₁₈SO₁₂ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.43 Å. Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.81 Å. P is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one S and three equivalent O atoms. The P-S bond length is 2.05 Å. All P-O bond lengths are 1.53 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.64 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. S is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one P atom. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na, one Sr, and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Sr, and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one P and three H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Sr and two H atoms.
